The '''NaQoit Bandits''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], they had a run-in with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mako Spince]] in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]], leaving Spince crippled.<ref name="rebeldawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>
